intro.title: The Underground
intro.text:
The gym smells of sweat, leather and tired neon.

Your coach, Malik, drops a file on the stool.

**"Tonight is your entry into the rankings. Win, and contracts start coming. Lose, and it's not over. But the road will be longer."**

You wrap your hands.

First opponent: **Viktor Mendez**.

choices.text: Get in the ring without reading the file

analyse_mendez.title: Breakdown — Viktor Mendez
analyse_mendez.narrator: The win starts before the first punch.
analyse_mendez.text:
Style:
- constant pressure
- jab, then left hook
- likes to pin you against the ropes

Weaknesses:
- opens up his liver after the hook
- tires if you make him miss
- hates close-quarters work

Malik taps the file.

**"Remember this: jab, hook, opening to the body."**

vestiaire_mendez.title: First Fight
vestiaire_mendez.narrator: The crowd always sounds louder before you walk out.
vestiaire_mendez.text:
Your name echoes.

Malik tightens your gloves.

**"Read his shoulders. Don't react at random."**

The ring lights swallow you.

mendez_1.title: Round 1 — Jab, Hook
mendez_1.text:
Mendez moves in.

Quick jab.

His left shoulder drops.

The hook is coming.

choices.text: Slip right, then hook to the liver

mendez_good_1.title: Liver Shot
mendez_good_1.text:
You slip to the right.

His hook sails past.

Your glove sinks in under his ribs.

Mendez winces.

mendez_block_1.title: High Guard
mendez_block_1.narrator: You survive, but he gains ground.
mendez_block_1.text:
The hook smacks against your gloves.

Mendez pushes forward.

The ropes are behind you.

mendez_bad_1.title: Clean Hit
mendez_bad_1.text:
The hook catches you on the temple.

The ring tilts.

Malik yells:

**"Read him!"**

mendez_2.title: Round 1 — Close Quarters
mendez_2.text:
Mendez presses his forehead against yours.

He wants to shove you into the ropes.

choices.text: Clinch and lean your weight on him

mendez_good_2.title: You Break His Rhythm
mendez_good_2.narrator: The crowd doesn't always appreciate smart boxing.
mendez_good_2.text:
You tie him up.

You make him carry your weight.

Mendez gasps for air.

The referee separates you.

mendez_neutral_2.title: Short Exchange
mendez_neutral_2.text:
Your uppercut lands.

Mendez answers to the body.

The bell rings.

mendez_bad_2.title: Too Wide
mendez_bad_2.text:
Your hook is too wide.

Mendez ducks under it.

Two shots to the body.

The bell saves you.

coin_mendez.title: The Corner — Malik
coin_mendez.narrator: Between rounds, the fight goes on in your head.
coin_mendez.text:
Malik pours water over your neck.

**"He always drops his guard after the hook. But watch out: he knows you've seen it now. He'll feint."**

mendez_3.title: Round 2 — The Feint
mendez_3.narrator: He knows you saw his hook.
mendez_3.text:
Mendez advances.

Jab.

Left shoulder low.

But his eyes drop to your belly.

A feint?

choices.text: Don't bite, keep your guard tight

mendez_good_3.title: You Read the Trap
mendez_good_3.narrator: This time, you see it coming.
mendez_good_3.text:
You hold your ground.

His body hook clips your elbow.

He's too close.

Opening.

mendez_neutral_3.title: Stop Jab
mendez_neutral_3.text:
Your jab cuts off his attack.

Mendez slows down.

You take the round without flash.

mendez_bad_3.title: You Bite
mendez_bad_3.text:
You slip to the right.

Mendez is waiting for you.

His straight cuts off your escape.

You drop to one knee.

mendez_ko.title: Mendez Goes Down
mendez_ko.narrator: The first big crowd roar of your career.
mendez_ko.text:
Your short hook lands.

Mendez hits the canvas on his backside.

He rises at the count of eight.

But he's not really there anymore.

mendez_ko_win.title: Knockout Win
mendez_ko_win.narrator: The doors open faster when you make noise.
mendez_ko_win.text:
The referee waves it off.

Winner.

A promoter in a suit is already waiting for you.

**"Bigger. Riskier. Better paid."**

mendez_decision.title: Points Win
mendez_decision.text:
Unanimous decision.

Winner.

Malik nods.

**"You boxed with your head."**

mendez_loss.title: First Defeat
mendez_loss.narrator: Losing a fight doesn't mean losing a career.
mendez_loss.text:
You finish on your feet.

But the decision is clear.

Loss.

In the locker room, Malik doesn't yell.

**"Now you know what it feels like. We rebuild."**

choices.text: Go back to the small circuits

contrat_promoteur.title: The Quick Contract
contrat_promoteur.narrator: Shiny contracts often hide the hardest punches.
contrat_promoteur.text:
The promoter's name is Sorel.

**"Fight in three weeks. Undefeated opponent. Local TV."**

Malik doesn't like it.

**"Too soon."**

Sorel smiles.

**"Champions don't wait until they're ready."**

contrat_malik.title: The Patient Road
contrat_malik.narrator: Some paths climb slowly, but break fewer bones.
contrat_malik.text:
You refuse to rush.

Malik smiles.

**"Regional tournament. Three fights. Win, and you make the top ranks. Lose, and you learn."**

circuit_secondaire.title: The Small Circuits
circuit_secondaire.text:
You go back down a level.

Small gyms.

Worn-out gloves.

You win one fight.

Then another.

Malik says:

**"An undefeated boxer doesn't know yet who he is. You're just starting."**

choices.text: Climb back toward the regional tournament

doute.title: The Night After
doute.narrator: The punches pass. The doubt stays.
doute.text:
You replay the hook.

Again.

Malik finally calls.

**"Come tomorrow. Even if you don't want to. Especially if you don't want to."**

analyse_drago.title: Breakdown — Ivan Drago
analyse_drago.narrator: The quick contract leads to a wall.
analyse_drago.text:
Style:
- enormous power
- low output
- every mistake costs you

Weaknesses:
- slow to start
- poor at handling angles
- gets angry if you refuse to trade

Malik shuts the file.

**"Never stand in front of him. Never."**

drago_1.title: Drago — The Hammer
drago_1.narrator: One bad choice can end it all.
drago_1.text:
Drago moves forward slowly.

No jab.

Just a heavy right being loaded.

choices.text: Slip out to the left angle

drago_good.title: Angle Found
drago_good.text:
You step off his line.

His right cuts through empty air.

You land two shots to the body.

choices.text: Refuse to trade all the way through

drago_block.title: Blocked, Still Hurts
drago_block.narrator: Power goes right through the gloves.
drago_block.text:
You block.

Your arm goes heavy.

You realize blocking is not a solution.

drago_ko_loss.title: Brutal KO
drago_ko_loss.narrator: Some lessons turn out the lights.
drago_ko_loss.text:
You trade punches.

A mistake.

The right hand arrives.

Darkness.

choices.text: Wake up in the medical room

drago_win.title: The Upset
drago_win.narrator: A win that comes too fast creates a legend too early.
drago_win.text:
You make him miss.

Round after round.

A surprise decision.

Malik doesn't smile.

**"Now they'll want to burn you faster."**

drago_survive_loss.title: Brave Defeat
drago_survive_loss.narrator: You lose, but you stay on your feet.
drago_survive_loss.text:
Drago wins on points.

The crowd applauds anyway.

Your name starts circulating.

apres_drago.title: After the Dark
apres_drago.narrator: The body forgets less quickly than the ego.
apres_drago.text:
You wake up.

Malik is sitting by the bed.

**"Bad contract. But not the end of your career. Unless you decide it is."**

tournoi_regional.title: Regional Tournament
tournoi_regional.narrator: A real career begins when the fights start piling up.
tournoi_regional.text:
Next opponent: **Elias Reed**.

Style:
- counter-puncher
- waits for mistakes
- very good straight right
- weak when forced to lead

Malik sums it up:

**"Don't throw yourself at him. Make him come to you."**

reed_1.title: Reed — The Counter-Puncher
reed_1.narrator: He's waiting for you to make the mistake.
reed_1.text:
Reed barely moves.

High guard.

He wants you to come in.

choices.text: Charge in with a straight right

reed_good.title: You Make Him React
reed_good.text:
You feint.

Reed bites, just a little.

His straight punch flies into empty air.

Open flank.

choices.text: Hit the body, then step out

reed_neutral.title: Patience
reed_neutral.narrator: The crowd is bored. A good sign.
reed_neutral.text:
You circle.

Reed waits.

Malik yells:

**"Make him start it!"**

reed_bad.title: Head-On Collision
reed_bad.text:
You move in too straight.

Reed catches you with his straight right.

Clean.

reed_bad2.title: Greedy
reed_bad2.text:
You charge.

Reed is waiting for you.

Straight right.

Hook.

You stay on your feet.

reed_2.title: Reed Finally Moves Forward
reed_2.text:
Reed advances.

He doesn't like it.

His lead foot drags.

coin_reed.title: The Corner — Clarity
coin_reed.text:
Malik shakes you.

**"Do you want to impress or win? Make him come forward, jab, step out. Nothing else."**

reed_win.title: Regional Victory
reed_win.narrator: A smart win changes how people look at you.
reed_win.text:
Unanimous decision.

You win.

The rankings open up.

Next stop: **Lena Ward**, interclub champion.

reed_close.title: Split Decision
reed_close.narrator: Winning ugly still counts as winning.
reed_close.text:
Split decision.

You win by a narrow margin.

Malik says:

**"A career is also about winning ugly."**

analyse_ward.title: Breakdown — Lena Ward
analyse_ward.narrator: At this level, weaknesses look like traps.
analyse_ward.text:
Style:
- changes rhythm
- constant feints
- excellent lateral movement
- punishes predictable counters

Weaknesses:
- drops her guard after three jabs
- doesn't like body shots late in the round
- gets impatient when the crowd boos

Malik looks at you.

**"The file isn't enough anymore. You have to feel the moment."**

choices.text: Memorize: three jabs, then open up
Take a few undercard fights before Ward

ward_1.title: Ward — First Rhythm
ward_1.text:
Ward circles.

Jab.

Pause.

Jab.

Longer pause.

A third jab?

ward_good.title: The Third Jab
ward_good.text:
The third jab goes out.

Her guard drops.

Just a fraction.

ward_neutral.title: You Survive the Rhythm
ward_neutral.text:
You back up.

Ward smiles.

She sets the tempo.

ward_bad.title: Punished
ward_bad.narrator: She was waiting for your impatience.
ward_bad.text:
You jump too early.

Ward slips.

Her counter lands clean.

ward_2.title: End of Round
ward_2.text:
Ward picks up the pace.

High guard.

Body open.

ward_good2.title: She Folds
ward_good2.text:
First shot to the body.

Second one.

Ward backs up.

The bell rings.

ward_neutral2.title: Close Round
ward_neutral2.text:
You cover up.

Ward lands a few.

Malik clenches his jaw.

ward_bad2.title: Too High
ward_bad2.text:
You go for the head.

Ward disappears.

Her hook takes your legs out from under you.

coin_ward.title: Final Advice
coin_ward.narrator: The last round decides the career.
coin_ward.text:
Malik talks fast.

**"If you've got the legs, cut off her exit. If not, clinch and steal the seconds. The champion is the one who makes the right decision when tired."**

ward_final.title: Final Round — Ward
ward_final.text:
Ward feints.

Jab.

Jab.

She waits for your counter.

Her back foot slips.

She sets up her lateral escape.

choices.text: Cut off the exit and hit the body

ward_win.title: Victory — Interclub Title
ward_win.narrator: You've just become someone in this sport.
ward_win.text:
You cut off her escape.

Body.

More body.

Decision.

Victory.

You break into the top of the rankings.

ward_top3.title: Split Decision
ward_top3.narrator: You didn't dominate. You survived intelligently.
ward_top3.text:
You clinch.

You steal the seconds.

Split decision.

Victory.

You finish in the top 3.

ward_loss.title: Loss to Ward
ward_loss.narrator: You were close. Not close enough.
ward_loss.text:
You go for the counter.

Ward had read it.

You finish on your feet.

But the decision is clear.

Fourth this season.

Not an ending.

A place to climb past.

fin_champion.title: Ending — Rising Champion
fin_champion.narrator: The summit is never the end.
fin_champion.text:
You finish the season as interclub champion.

Contracts start coming in.

You're not the best in the world yet.

But nobody laughs when you say you want to be.

Malik hangs the belt on the wall.

**"Now the real work begins."**

fin_top3.title: Ending — Top 3
fin_top3.text:
You finish in the top 3.

Not undefeated.

Not untouchable.

But respected.

Malik says:

**"Flashy burns out fast. Smart lasts."**

choices.text: Attempt a comeback for the title

fin_quatrieme.title: Ending — Fourth Place
fin_quatrieme.narrator: A career is also judged by the place you refuse to give up.
fin_quatrieme.text:
You finish fourth.

No title.

But in the gyms, boxers know your name.

You lost.

You learned.

Next season, nobody wants to draw you in the first round.

choices.text: Keep fighting in the small gyms

fin_abandon.title: Ending — Gloves in the Closet
fin_abandon.narrator: Sometimes, surviving means leaving the ring.
fin_abandon.text:
You don't go back to the gym.

One day, you find your old gloves.

They still smell of leather and fear.

You never became a champion.

But climbing into a ring even once already took courage.

choices.text: Hang up the gloves for good

hub_combats_annexes.title: The Secondary Circuit
hub_combats_annexes.narrator: Careers never climb in a straight line.
hub_combats_annexes.text:
Sorel offers you several contracts.

Small halls.
Local TV.
Dangerous fights.
Odd styles.

Malik sighs.

**"Some fights will make you better. Others will just wreck you. Choose carefully."**

Eight files are spread out on the table.

choices.text: Fight Luis Ortega — the mobile southpaw
Fight Pavel Kruger — the slow heavy hitter
Fight Jin Mori — the defensive technician
Fight Hassan Vale — the dirty brawler
Go back to preparing for Ward

hub_combats_annexes_2.title: The Other Files
hub_combats_annexes_2.narrator: The more you read the names, the more the career looks like a maze.
hub_combats_annexes_2.text:
Malik slides four more files toward you.

**"These ones aren't necessarily stronger. But they're different. And different, in the ring, usually means dangerous."**

choices.text: Fight Alexei Petrov — the former Olympian
Fight Miguel Santos — the explosive puncher
Fight Derek Hayes — the patient counter-puncher
Fight Elio Nova — the fast showman

ortega_intro.title: Breakdown — Luis Ortega
ortega_intro.narrator: Every boxer has a fatal habit.
ortega_intro.text:
File: **Luis Ortega**

Style:
- mobile southpaw

Analysis:
- He always steps out to the right after his jab. His liver stays open when he pivots.

Malik sums it up:

**"You don't have to be perfect. You just have to recognize THE moment."**

ortega_fight.title: Luis Ortega — Key Exchange
ortega_fight.narrator: Everything is decided in a few seconds.
ortega_fight.text:
Ortega jabs and pivots to the right. His left elbow rises.

The opening is brief.

Very brief.

choices.text: Hook to the liver during his pivot
Follow his pivot with your guard low

ortega_win.title: Victory over Luis Ortega
ortega_win.narrator: Every win shifts your career a little.
ortega_win.text:
You read Luis Ortega perfectly.

The crowd reacts instantly.

Malik almost looks proud.

**"Now you're really starting to understand the ring."**

ortega_neutral.title: Close Fight
ortega_neutral.narrator: Sometimes surviving is already a win.
ortega_neutral.text:
The fight stays close.

You hold on.

So does Luis Ortega.

The decision could go either way.

choices.text: Stop taking risks and prepare for Ward

ortega_loss.title: Loss to Luis Ortega
ortega_loss.narrator: Defeats sometimes build more than victories.
ortega_loss.text:
Luis Ortega wins.

You take a lot of punishment.

A lot.

But Malik looks at you with curiosity.

**"Now we'll see what you do after you've suffered."**

kruger_intro.title: Breakdown — Pavel Kruger
kruger_intro.narrator: Every boxer has a fatal habit.
kruger_intro.text:
File: **Pavel Kruger**

Style:
- slow heavy hitter

Analysis:
- His punches are dangerous but long. If he misses twice, he breathes hard.

Malik sums it up:

**"You don't have to be perfect. You just have to recognize THE moment."**

kruger_fight.title: Pavel Kruger — Key Exchange
kruger_fight.narrator: Everything is decided in a few seconds.
kruger_fight.text:
Kruger winds up a massive right. All his weight goes forward.

The opening is brief.

Very brief.

kruger_win.title: Victory over Pavel Kruger
kruger_win.narrator: Every win shifts your career a little.
kruger_win.text:
You read Pavel Kruger perfectly.

The crowd reacts instantly.

Malik almost looks proud.

**"Now you're really starting to understand the ring."**

kruger_neutral.title: Close Fight
kruger_neutral.narrator: Sometimes surviving is already a win.
kruger_neutral.text:
The fight stays close.

You hold on.

So does Pavel Kruger.

The decision could go either way.

choices.text: Stop taking risks and prepare for Ward

kruger_loss.title: Loss to Pavel Kruger
kruger_loss.narrator: Defeats sometimes build more than victories.
kruger_loss.text:
Pavel Kruger wins.

You take a lot of punishment.

A lot.

But Malik looks at you with curiosity.

**"Now we'll see what you do after you've suffered."**

mori_intro.title: Breakdown — Jin Mori
mori_intro.narrator: Every boxer has a fatal habit.
mori_intro.text:
File: **Jin Mori**

Style:
- defensive technician

Analysis:
- He waits for clean attacks. He hates short, messy combinations.

Malik sums it up:

**"You don't have to be perfect. You just have to recognize THE moment."**

mori_fight.title: Jin Mori — Key Exchange
mori_fight.narrator: Everything is decided in a few seconds.
mori_fight.text:
Mori stays still. He waits for your jab as if he already knows what comes next.

The opening is brief.

Very brief.

mori_win.title: Victory over Jin Mori
mori_win.narrator: Every win shifts your career a little.
mori_win.text:
You read Jin Mori perfectly.

The crowd reacts instantly.

Malik almost looks proud.

**"Now you're really starting to understand the ring."**

mori_neutral.title: Close Fight
mori_neutral.narrator: Sometimes surviving is already a win.
mori_neutral.text:
The fight stays close.

You hold on.

So does Jin Mori.

The decision could go either way.

choices.text: Stop taking risks and prepare for Ward

mori_loss.title: Loss to Jin Mori
mori_loss.narrator: Defeats sometimes build more than victories.
mori_loss.text:
Jin Mori wins.

You take a lot of punishment.

A lot.

vale_intro.title: Breakdown — Hassan Vale
vale_intro.narrator: Every boxer has a fatal habit.
vale_intro.text:
File: **Hassan Vale**

Style:
- dirty brawler

Analysis:
- He clinches, shoulders in, hits right at the edge of the rules. His guard opens after his clinches.

Malik sums it up:

**"You don't have to be perfect. You just have to recognize THE moment."**

vale_fight.title: Hassan Vale — Key Exchange
vale_fight.narrator: Everything is decided in a few seconds.
vale_fight.text:
Vale clinches you. His shoulder pushes your chin. The referee barely sees a thing.

The opening is brief.

Very brief.

choices.text: Short uppercut as you break from the clinch
Fight back dirty and lose your cool

vale_win.title: Victory over Hassan Vale
vale_win.narrator: Every win shifts your career a little.
vale_win.text:
You read Hassan Vale perfectly.

The crowd reacts instantly.

Malik almost looks proud.

vale_neutral.narrator: Sometimes surviving is already a win.
vale_neutral.text:
The fight stays close.

You hold on.

So does Hassan Vale.

The decision could go either way.

vale_loss.narrator: Defeats sometimes build more than victories.
vale_loss.text:
Hassan Vale wins.

A lot.

petrov_intro.title: Breakdown — Alexei Petrov
petrov_intro.narrator: Every boxer has a fatal habit.
petrov_intro.text:
File: **Alexei Petrov**

Style:
- former Olympian

Analysis:
- Very clean, very predictable. Three jabs, left step out, back to center.

Malik sums it up:

**"You don't have to be perfect. You just have to recognize THE moment."**

petrov_fight.title: Alexei Petrov — Key Exchange
petrov_fight.narrator: Everything is decided in a few seconds.
petrov_fight.text:
Petrov throws his third jab. His left foot is already looking for the exit.

The opening is brief.

Very brief.

choices.text: Cut off the exit with a short hook
Wait for him to finish his combination

petrov_win.title: Victory over Alexei Petrov
petrov_win.narrator: Every win shifts your career a little.
petrov_win.text:

A lot.

santos_intro.narrator: Every boxer has a fatal habit.
santos_intro.text:
File: **Miguel Santos**

Style:
- explosive puncher

Analysis:
- Terrifying first minute. But his confidence cracks if you don't put him down fast.

Malik sums it up:

**"You don't have to be perfect. You just have to recognize THE moment."**

santos_fight.title: Miguel Santos — Key Exchange
santos_fight.narrator: Everything is decided in a few seconds.
santos_fight.text:
Santos explodes the moment the bell rings. Three punches come without a breath.

The opening is brief.

Very brief.

choices.text: Clinch right away to wear him out
Look for the show in the center

santos_win.title: Victory over Miguel Santos
santos_win.narrator: Every win shifts your career a little.
santos_win.text:

A lot.

hayes_intro.title: Breakdown — Derek Hayes
hayes_intro.narrator: Every boxer has a fatal habit.
hayes_intro.text:
File: **Derek Hayes**

Style:
- patient counter-puncher

Analysis:
- He never starts a fight. If you give him the center, he gets uncomfortable.

Malik sums it up:

**"You don't have to be perfect. You just have to recognize THE moment."**

hayes_fight.title: Derek Hayes — Key Exchange
hayes_fight.narrator: Everything is decided in a few seconds.
hayes_fight.text:
Hayes waits. His gloves don't move. He wants your first move.

The opening is brief.

Very brief.

choices.text: Give him the center and feint
Charge in with a straight right

hayes_win.title: Victory over Derek Hayes
hayes_win.narrator: Every win shifts your career a little.

A lot.

But Malik looks at you with curiosity.

**"Now we'll see what you do after you've suffered."**

nova_intro.title: Breakdown — Elio Nova
nova_intro.narrator: Every boxer has a fatal habit.
nova_intro.text:
File: **Elio Nova**

Style:
- fast showman

Analysis:
- He plays to the crowd. When he smiles at the cameras, his chin stays up.

Malik sums it up:

**"You don't have to be perfect. You just have to recognize THE moment."**

nova_fight.title: Elio Nova — Key Exchange
nova_fight.narrator: Everything is decided in a few seconds.
nova_fight.text:
Nova smiles at the front row. His arm drops for a split second.

The opening is brief.

Very brief.

choices.text: Let him put on his show

nova_win.title: Victory over Elio Nova
nova_win.narrator: Every win shifts your career a little.
nova_win.text:
You read Elio Nova perfectly.

The crowd reacts instantly.

Malik almost looks proud.

**"Now you're really starting to understand the ring."**

nova_neutral.title: Close Fight
nova_neutral.narrator: Sometimes surviving is already a win.
nova_neutral.text:
The fight stays close.

You hold on.

So does Elio Nova.

The decision could go either way.

choices.text: Stop taking risks and prepare for Ward

nova_loss.title: Loss to Elio Nova
nova_loss.narrator: Defeats sometimes build more than victories.
nova_loss.text:
Elio Nova wins.

You take a lot of punishment.

A lot.

But Malik looks at you with curiosity.

**"Now we'll see what you do after you've suffered."**

fin_entraineur.title: Ending — Trainer
fin_entraineur.narrator: A career is sometimes passed on better than it is won.
fin_entraineur.text:
You never became the greatest.

But years later, in a small gym that still smells of leather and sweat, a young boxer asks you:

**"Coach... how do you read a feint?"**

You smile.

And for a moment, you see Malik again.

fin_consultant.title: Ending — TV Analyst
fin_consultant.narrator: Understanding the ring is sometimes another kind of victory.
fin_consultant.text:
You build a reputation as a technician.

Sports channels start inviting you on.

You break down fights better than many former champions.

Fans learn to read the game the way you do.

fin_boxeur_peuple.title: Ending — People's Boxer
fin_boxeur_peuple.narrator: Some legends never wear a belt.
fin_boxeur_peuple.text:
You never became champion.

But people come to see you.

Because they know you might fall.

But never without getting back up.

fin_retour.title: Ending — The Comeback
fin_retour.narrator: You're only truly finished when you accept being finished.
fin_retour.text:
Everyone thought you were finished.

Too many defeats.
Too many injuries.

Then one night, you come back.

And everyone rises to their feet.

fin_abandon_definitif.title: Ending — Gloves in the Closet
fin_abandon_definitif.narrator: Sometimes, surviving means leaving the ring.
fin_abandon_definitif.text:
You don't go back to the gym.

One day, you find your old gloves.

They still smell of leather and fear.

You never became champion.

But climbing into a ring even once already took courage.
